<thought>Using the retrieved formula for DBE: DBE = (2*C + 2 - H)/2 (ignoring O). For C16H15O, DBE = (2*16 + 2 - 15)/2 = (32 + 2 - 15)/2 = 19/2 = 9.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the correct integer value is 10 (rounding up to the nearest whole number).</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
